decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 8th February 2018 and numbered RA275/01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, location plan (unnumbered) and plans submitted 28th March 2018 and numbered RA275/R07DSrevA, 08DSrevA, 09DSrevA, 10DSrevA, 11DSrevA, 12DSrevA and 13DSrevA (all Revision C) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the first floor rear elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a first floor side extension to the house.
